{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for imbalance in customer_segment across channels
segment_channel_cross = pd.crosstab(df_filtered['channel'], df_filtered['customer_segment'])
print(f'Cross-tabulation of channel and customer_segment after filtering:\n{segment_channel_cross}')

# Compute average revenue per order by channel and segment
avg_revenue_by_channel_segment = df_filtered.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'\nAverage revenue per order by channel and segment:\n{avg_revenue_by_channel_segment}')

# Compute overall average revenue by channel (unadjusted)
avg_revenue_unadjusted = df_filtered.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'\nUnadjusted average revenue by channel:\n{avg_revenue_unadjusted}')

# Compute adjusted average revenue by channel using weighted average (to account for segment imbalance)
# Weight by segment size in each channel
total_orders_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby('channel').size()
segment_size_by_channel = df_filtered.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment']).size()

# Compute segment weights within each channel
weights = segment_size_by_channel / total_orders_by_channel

# Compute weighted average revenue per channel
weighted_avg_revenue = (avg_revenue_by_channel_segment * weights).groupby('channel').sum()
print(f'\nWeighted average revenue per channel (adjusted for segment imbalance):\n{weighted_avg_revenue}')

# Compare unadjusted vs adjusted
print(f'\nDifference (unadjusted - adjusted):\n{avg_revenue_unadjusted - weighted_avg_revenue}')"}
